title: eranthemum acanthophorum
intro: Eranthemum acanthophorum, commonly known as the "Hill Candra", is a species of flowering plant in the family Acanthaceae. The Hill Candra is known for its potential health benefits, which include anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties. The therapeutic actions of Eranthemum acanthophorum include soothing skin irritations, reducing fever, and fighting off infections. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
